operations.summary: Exchange a billing bridge one-time ticket for a console session
operations.description: Called by the console page /sso/bridge?ticket=… without Authorization (the ticket is the credential). Signs the customer in with an ordinary session of its own (not impersonation; audit auth.login with authentication_method billing_bridge and auth.session.bridge_sso). Expired, reused, unknown, disabled-user and terminated-service tickets are all 401 bridge_sso_invalid. The account's e-mail/SMS login verification is skipped; when the plugin setting sso_require_mfa is on and the customer has TOTP, the first call is 401 mfa_required and the same ticket is sent again with authentication (mfa_invalid_code, mfa_code_replayed on a wrong code; five wrong codes void the ticket).

responses.description: Signed in. The refresh token is set only as an HttpOnly cookie.
